messages:
katie: Heads up — after the quant branch merged into main the scorecard drilldown for the new bfloat8 variants is showing an empty sample list for several tests. The scorecard summary numbers look ok, but clicking any cell yields an empty table.

omar: Repro'd locally, same. Summary tiles have counts, drilldown modal says "0 samples". :thinking_face:

matt: Any errors in console/network when you open the drilldown? Could be the API returning 204 or a schema mismatch.

katie: Chrome devtools shows 200 from /api/evals/drilldown but response body is [] 

jun: That's weird — I see samples in the runner artifact for that run. The runner uploaded artifacts at 2026-03-18T22:08:02Z. eval-bot: upload complete: run-98765/artifacts.json (size 8.1MB).

ana: (typo) 

ana: oops meant ana: Looking at the ingest logs, the ingest service logged "schema version mismatch: samples.v2 expected, samples.v3 found" around the time of that run. Might be the quant PR bumped the runner artifact schema to attach tokenization metadata.

matt: If the UI expects samples.v2, it will query samples.v2 index and get nothing. Can someone paste the ingest log snippet?

omar: Log snippet: ```
2026-03-18T22:08:10Z INFO ingest: run=98765 artifacts parsed version=samples.v3 fields=[id,text,tokens,quant_meta]
2026-03-18T22:08:10Z WARN ingest: run=98765 index=samples.v2 not found, skipping
```

katie: Ok that explains empty drilldown. But why did ingest not index into samples.v2? Was a migration missed? The PR that added quant_meta should have a compat path.

jun: The runner change introduced quant_meta at top-level and bumped the version constant to v3. I missed a migration shim. On the ingestion side we have a switch that routes by artifact.version — it only knows v1/v2.

ana: Quick patch: ingest service can fallback by transforming v3->v2 (drop quant_meta and normalize tokens). I pushed a small patch to conjure a shim and started a canary deploy in staging.

matt: For the immediate customer-facing fix we can add a UI fallback: if drilldown empty but summary count >0, call the alternate endpoint /api/evals/drilldown?version=v3 and display results. That avoids a hotfix deploy to ingest.

katie: Agreed — do both. Ana, can you finish the ingest shim? Jun/matt can add the UI fallback? I'll own coordination and testing.

ana: Shim PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/PR/412 — adds v3->v2 mapping, unit tests included. Deployed to staging, ingest logs now show indexing into samples.v2 for run=98765.

matt: UI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/PR/688 — drilldown will attempt v2 then v3 if v2 returns empty but summary count indicates hits. Includes telemetry flag `drilldown_schema_fallback`.

omar: Running manual test: opened scorecard for run-98765, drilldown now shows 120 sample rows, tokenization column present (we hide quant_meta in UI). :tada:

jun: Follow-up items: 1) Add schema compatibility tests in CI for runner artifacts (generate v2/v3 artifacts and validate ingest). 2) Add a flag to runner config to emit legacy artifacts for a while. 3) Update eval docs about artifact schema.

katie: I'll create the ticket for CI tests and docs. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MLENG-784. Assigning to jun for runner flag and to matt for UI telemetry.

eval-bot: NOTE: retro reminder — when bumping artifact schema, please add a semver-like release note in the eval-harness changelog and tag ingest team in the PR description.

matt: Good call. Also check diff view: there was a separate visual issue where quantized model diff plots had misaligned sample ids due to tokenization differences; that will be handled in the v3->v2 mapping but might need a follow-up to surface tokenization diffs in the UI.

katie: Thanks all — rolling this into the post-merge checklist and will validate in prod tomorrow after the ingest rollout. If anyone sees further oddities, drop them here and I'll escalate.

ana: thumbs up 

omar: :eyes: monitoring prod logs for the next 2 hours

jun: I'll open the CI test PR today.

matt: Deploying console patch to canary now.
